function.description: Append content to a file in the workspace. Pass after_anchor to insert immediately AFTER the first line containing that exact text instead of at the end — use it to add a row to the TOP of a newest-first table (anchor on the table's |---|---| separator) without rewriting the file. An anchor that matches nothing, or matches more than one line, refuses and writes nothing.
function.name: filesystem_append_file

parameters.description: Model for appending content to a file in the workspace
